method.policy: One shared Dark type profile for original and Oracle wording. Geometry fits 15 preregistered calibration printings; the fine ink objective checks filled stroke area, signed contrast and stroke width. The 88 validation cards were retained from preceding studies and are repeated validation, not a new holdout. Frame poses are frozen independently; no per-card type shifts. Full structural indices are not correctness percentages.
method.candidates: Geometry fixed before ink fitting. Ink search uses gray 176/192/208/224/240, shadow 0.5 through 2 at 0.25 intervals and trim 0/0.1/0.2/0.3. A wider shadow grid confirmed the same winner. Fine ink scoring retains local normalization without the earlier 3x3 blur.
method.isolation: Native capture preserves the earlier original input, including the old Electric Eel body, to isolate type pixels. Its reviewed wording correction is tracked separately and must enter subsequent body measurements.
method.exclusions: Ball Lightning has rejected frame normalization and is not scored. Gaea’s Touch printing 77† has a printing ink shift and stays a diagnostic, not a geometry fit input. Wormwood Treefolk retains a small fine-shape regression.
